title: Honeybound
description: A side-scrolling platformer: Tobin the young beekeeper runs, stomps and bounces through eight stages to free the Great Hive from Baron Thornwick.

tracks.chords: I IV I V I IV ii V
i IV i VII i IV VII i
I vi IV V I iii IV I

rescue_1: BUZZ: TOBIN! YOU CAME FOR ME! THE BARON HAD ME LOCKED IN HIS LARDER.
MARIGOLD: OH, TOBIN! I AM THE HIVE'S MAPMAKER. THANK YOU!
BRAMWELL: WELL STUNG, YOUNG KEEPER! OLD BRAMWELL THANKS YOU.
SORREL: BRRR! SORREL OF THE NIGHT SHIFT, AT YOUR SERVICE.
THISTLEDOWN: ROYAL GUARD. I TRIED TO STOP HIM, TOBIN. I REALLY DID.
FENNEL: THE QUEEN'S COOK! THEY MADE ME BAKE THORN PIES ALL WEEK.
BURDOCK: CAPTAIN OF THE HIVE GUARD. THE ASHLANDS LIE AHEAD.
rescue_2: BUT QUEEN MELLI IS NOT HERE. HE CARRIED HER EAST, PAST THE DUSKWOOD.
HIS CARRIAGE WENT THROUGH AUTUMN HOLLOW. THE LEAVES ARE STILL FALLING WHERE IT PASSED.
THE BARON FLED NORTH INTO FROSTVALE. MIND THE ICE: IT IS SLIPPERY, AND SO IS HE.
HE TOOK THE QUEEN ACROSS THE SUNSET DUNES. FOLLOW THE BEACONS SOUTH.
HE IS HEADED FOR THE STARLIT MEADOW, WHERE THE GRUBBLES NEVER SLEEP.
SHE IS NEAR NOW. THE BARON HID HER BEYOND BLOSSOM RIDGE.
THE BARON'S CITADEL STANDS AT THEIR HEART, AND THE QUEEN IS INSIDE.
rescue_3: FOLLOW THE BEACONS. I WILL TELL THE HIVE YOU ARE ON YOUR WAY!
THE QUEEN IS FURTHER STILL. HURRY!
THE QUEEN'S SONG CAN STILL BE HEARD ON THE COLD WIND.
AND TAKE SOME HONEY FOR THE ROAD. YOU HAVE EARNED IT.
HE IS AFRAID OF YOU, TOBIN. I SAW IT IN HIS FEELERS.
FINISH THIS, KEEPER. THE WHOLE HIVE IS WITH YOU.

ui.text: TOBIN AND THE BARON OF THORNS
HOLD X TO RUN (AND THROW SEEDS)
DOWN ON A HOLLOW LOG: GO INSIDE

lines.text: BRAVE LITTLE KEEPER... THE BARON WANTED EVERY FLOWER FOR HIS THORNS.
YOU CROSSED EIGHT WORLDS WITH NOTHING BUT A HAT AND A FEW SEEDS.
COME, TOBIN. THE HIVE HAS BEEN SAVING THE SWEETEST HONEY FOR YOU.

scenarios.name: the title starts a game, the card names the stage, then Tobin plays 1-1
landing on a grubble flattens it and bounces Tobin up
bumping a comb from below brings royal jelly, and eating it makes Tobin big
a second comb gives big Tobin a firebloom: seeds to throw
a brick hides a starpetal: star power plays its own tune
a stomped snail hides in its shell, and a kick sends the shell rolling
holding down on a hollow log leads to the honey room, and its side log comes out further along
after the midpoint a lost life starts Tobin there, not at the beginning
a pit costs a life and the card comes back
losing the last life is game over, then the title again with the best score kept
3-4 the rusted keep can be finished
4-4 the frozen keep can be finished
5-4 the sandstone keep can be finished
6-4 the midnight keep can be finished
7-4 the thornbloom keep can be finished
8-4 the baron's citadel can be finished
pausing stops the world until Z
